requirements.requirement: The system must render a sponsor credibility UI block within the MessageBubble component when sponsor data is present in the trial payload.
The system must display the sponsor name exactly as provided by the transformed rendering logic.
The system must display the sponsor type (e.g., industry, academic, government) in a clearly labeled field within the component.
The system must display the funding source label (public, private, or undisclosed) as provided by the rendering logic.
The system must render a list of collaborators when collaborator data is present.
The system must display the sponsor's contribution to the trial score as a human-readable text element.
The system must visually group sponsor name, type, funding source, collaborators, and score contribution within a single cohesive UI block.
The system must ensure the sponsor credibility block follows existing MessageBubble styling conventions for spacing, typography, and layout.
The system must render the sponsor credibility block without breaking or altering existing trial scorecard elements within the MessageBubble.
The system must conditionally hide the collaborators section if no collaborators are provided.
The system must display a fallback label of 'Undisclosed' when the funding source field is missing or null.
The system must not render the sponsor credibility block if the sponsor object is entirely absent from the payload.
The system must render partial sponsor data without crashing when one or more fields (type, collaborators, or score contribution) are missing.
The system must truncate or wrap long sponsor names and collaborator lists to prevent UI overflow within the MessageBubble.
The system must re-render the sponsor credibility component correctly when new trial data is received in the MessageBubble lifecycle.
